graph.name: Build a brief from JSON
graph.description:
Keep a few scene facts in an editable JSON source and render a stable instruction from named fields.

Lesson: Introduce an editable Text source with ordered Trim → Unwrap fence modifiers, then Text → Data parsing, bounded schema, named selection, an optional fallback and JSON-pointer templates without a model.

Limitations: This is authored reference Data, not live scene or actor storage. Missing required fields stop the graph.

Opening makes this example the active workflow document. Bind local model roles and provide the documented evidence before running.

Pre: at most 0 auxiliary calls. Preview before publishing or applying.

Try changing:
Change obstacle in the JSON source and compare the rendered brief without changing a model prompt.
Remove openChoice to see the explicit fallback; remove place to see required-field validation stop the run.
Disable Unwrap fence and inspect INVALID_JSON at JSON Decode; re-enable it and compare Raw output, Output and the ordered modifier trace.

Documentation specimen (does not seed chat or actor memory):

Situation: Ferry gate, closed for inspection, Mira present.

Guidance: At the ferry gate, preserve the obstacle: closed for inspection. Mira may respond. Leave the player free to wait or ask Mira about the delay.

Inspect each artifact: json (Text with Trim → Unwrap fence) → decode → fields; fields.out → render.data; render.out → publish.in. Schema is raw JSON text. Inspect raw/modified Text and its trace. No calls or live-state writes.

Ferry gate · editable facts (json)
Purpose: Keep editable reference facts in a Text source; clean its padded Markdown fence with ordered node-local modifiers.
Inspect: Compare Raw output, Output and Modifier trace. Trim both edges runs before Unwrap fence; JSON Decode receives the unwrapped raw JSON. Disabling Unwrap fence produces INVALID_JSON, not published guidance. Editing this source never seeds live memory.

Check the scene-fact shape (decode)
Purpose: Parse exactly the fields understood by this brief.
Inspect: Inspect parsed Data; a missing required field or misspelled extra field stops publication.

Name the template fields (fields)
Purpose: Project four values with one authored fallback.
Inspect: Inspect location, blocker, speaker and choice. The output deliberately renames source fields.

Render the open choice (render)
Purpose: Combine checked fields with an authored agency constraint.
Inspect: Wire fields.out → render.data. Data does not connect to named Text section inputs.

Offer the structured brief (publish)
Purpose: Bound the small rendered instruction.
Inspect: Inspect punctuation and exact substitution; JSON syntax should not leak into guidance.
